name: 39305 · Meridian, MS
findings: ZIP 39305 (Meridian) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39305 (Meridian) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 39305 (Meridian) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
